Title: Dry Eyes Blink Reminder Lite
ShortDescription: Two reminders in one app: a gentle cue to blink, and a 20-20-20 eye break. For dry eyes and digital eye strain. It appears on every monitor and never takes focus, so you can read, click and type straight through it. No network, no camera, no tracking.
Description:
Two reminders in one app: a gentle cue to blink, and a 20-20-20 eye break. It stays out of your way. You can click and type straight through it.

Staring at a screen roughly halves how often you blink, and many of the blinks that remain are incomplete. If your doctor has told you to blink more often, this helps you do it consistently.

BLINK CUE - VISUAL AND SOUND

A soft cue appears on screen every 30 seconds, or at any interval you choose. A gentle chime carries it when you don't see the cue. A blink reminder has to reach you even when your eyes are on something else. Four sounds, volume from 0% to 100%.

BREAK CUE - EVERY 20 MINUTES

The screen tints gently to remind you to look away and take a break. It runs on the wall clock, so it lands at the same minutes past the hour whenever you started the app. Choose 15, 20, 30 or 60 minutes. Twenty is the 20-20-20 rule your optometrist may have mentioned: every 20 minutes, look about 20 feet away for 20 seconds.

ON EVERY SCREEN

Reminders appear on every connected monitor, correctly sized on each one even when your displays run at different scaling. A small dot in the corner of each screen shows the app is running, with a countdown to the next break above it.

IT WON'T INTERRUPT YOU

The cue never takes focus, so it cannot swallow a keystroke, and it fades by itself. There is no pop-up, no window, and nothing to dismiss. Snooze it if needed.

CUSTOMISABLE - TURN ANYTHING DOWN, OR OFF

Four styles: a dot, a word of your own, a gentle dim, or a small corner dot.

Size, position, colour, strength, timing and sound are all customisable, and each reminder keeps its own settings, so the blink cue can be barely there while the break is harder to ignore. Preview any change before you save it. Anything you do not want, switch off.

Available in thirty languages, following the language Windows itself is displayed in, or set by hand from the top right of Settings.

NOTHING LEAVES YOUR DEVICE

No account. No sign-in. No ads, no analytics, no tracking. There is no network connection of any kind - the app never contacts any server, including ours.

It does not use your camera. It works on a timer; it does not watch you. And the reminder is rate-limited in code, so no combination of settings can exceed three flashes per second.

GOOD TO KNOW

The app runs in the notification area and has no main window. Right-click its tray icon for Settings.

This is a reminder to do something you may already have been advised to do. It is not a medical device and it does not diagnose or treat any condition. If your eyes hurt, or stay uncomfortable, see an eye-care professional.
